sourceText:
Pig Ears
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, January 2, 2010 - 12:44am

Ingredients




2 lbs. pork breakfast chops, sliced very thin
1/2 cup soy sauce
2 tablespoons sesame oil
1/4 cup sugar
4 cups Town House crackers, crushed
2 eggs
Water
2 tablespoons sugar
Oil for frying

Preparation

1 Slice chops into small pieces, 2 inches in diameter. (They will end up being sort of triangular shapes and look like pigs ears.) Marinate in next 3 ingredients overnight or at least 2 hours. Mix eggs, water and 2 tablespoons sugar in small bowl, beat. Dip each pork piece in cracker crumbs, then in egg, then in crackers again. Add to hot oil and deep fry about 3 to 4 minutes (until golden brown). Remove to drain.
